d:
Mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri se mulakat ko lekar prashant kishor ne apni chuppi tori hai. unhonne is mulakat ko samajik aur rajnitik shishtachar batate hue kaha ki milne ka matlab yah nahin hai ki unke rajnitik saval khatm ho jaenge.
Pike ne kaha ki samrat chaudhri par jo saval pahle uthae hain, unhen aage bhi uthate rahenge.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
